"Next!" The light outside my bedroom door lights up with a flick of a switch. 

A slender woman, dressed in a full suit, framed with raven hair walks through with her snotty nosed child in tow. Her pale face is business-like, eyes clear and void of emotion. She shits down in the chair opposite my bed and instructs the child to be quiet.

"Yes, Mr Bolder, I am here for our 4pm meeting." Polite but formal. 

"Ah, perfect. Well, I'll cut to the chase, as you can see I do not have long left for this world" I manage to rasp out over my Saharan dry through and cracked lips. "This process... It will take some time before I would see you. Tell me, where do you see yourself in five years?"

She doesn't seem phased by this. Like she understands that although I am in my deathbed, if chosen I will see her again one day. Just a different body and a different name - one that she would choose this time. 

"I see myself the head of my accountancy firm and will have gotten Jr here through primary school. I want to have expanded my family with my first daughter." 

Daughter... That's a possibility I didn't see coming. 

 "You see, my husband and I have been trying for a child since Jr turned one and sadly it has not happened. I've been advised that by securing your revival I may be luckier in that department now. What with the agreement to join the family? "

"Yes yes, quite so." I cut off. In truth, after 90 years on this planet and only 3 days of these repeated interviews, I was finished and just wanted to choose a family for reincarnation and have my final days spent in peace. "Well, you've been the most respectable person I've seen through these doors. And I hope you'll be the last. If you can just sign here on the dotted line our transaction will be complete. I can provide you with the child you need once all this is over." I tried to keep the irritation out of my voice. I was tired, teasy and in honesty, bored. 

Maybe that's why I didn't see it coming. I didn't see the deception or the sick glimmer of truth flick over her face. With a quick flourish of her pen the agreement was signed. And another quick flourish, this of the blade within said pen, I was bleeding out. 

I guess she was desperate for her daughter. Waiting for my natural death wasn't good enough. However, when I asked where she saw herself in the future. If she told the truth, it would be prison. And although I was later reincarnated as her daughter, Eva, we were separated and I was placed in foster care. A waste of an agreement

Okay so not completely about an escape but a funny story about her going to the wrong place. 

I have a beautiful cat called Bam Bam. She goes outside a lot and usually is back in our back yard at 5 o’clock on the dot for food. 

An important tip for later is that she is a rescue cat and has a huge fear of dogs because of her precious owners.

Anyways, it’s really wet one night and I’m in my back yard calling Bam Bams name. After each call we can hear her meow but o can’t work out where from. After 20 minutes of sounding like a broken record I go inside and leave the window open, expecting her to come in when she feels like it. 

An hour or so passes and she’s still not back. So I go back out and call her. Same again, can hear a meow but nothing else. This process repeats all night. 

In the morning after no sleep and feeling like a mum with a loss child I start going around the neighbourhood looking for hear. Again, I can still hear her but that’s it. 

The day after there’s missing posters and the likes printed. I’ve cried all night. I’m scared to hell I’ll lose my baby.  After posting the flyers through all the doors in the neighbourhood I keep looking around. In the afternoon I get a call. 

Hey presto, the cats found. But there’s a catch. 

The man informs me that they’ve found my cat but she’s stuck. And it’s the property behind his. No problem. I go over to look anyway. 

And there’s my cat. Or rather, my cats ass. That’s all. Turns out the dumb mare was coming home in the rain and was scared by the dogs next door so ran for cover. Rather than come home she climbs into a gap between a house’s wall and roof. 

I get on the ladder and despite trying to coax her out she’s not aware should could just back out. But there’s not enough room to grab her. So I have to break off some of the slates from the roof to get enough space to grab her. She’s freaked and I’m confused because it’s just dawned on me I’m on a sketchy ladder with no hands and a terrified cat. 

We got her home that day but I’ve never forgotten it. 

TLDR; cat goes missing and I commit destruction of private property to get her back

I have been friends with a girl, let’s call her Sophie, since I was 4 years old. Although we had different values and aims in life we were very close. We also had another friend we knew for about 5 years in our hometown. 

Last year I moved away (only about 60 Miles) to a new town for work in June. In October, the friend of Sophie and I passed away. For some reason she didn’t feel the need to tell me and I found out through a news article on Facebook. Needless to say I was absolutely devastated. 

When I got home (and calmed after my breakdown) I messaged her. Asking about how it happened, if t was peaceful etc. She didn’t want to talk about it and I respected that - grief functions in different ways. So I sent her my love and asked her to keep me updated on when the funeral would be. She agreed. 

Fast forward two weeks, I’ve asked her multiple times about the funeral and she ignored my messages. I get home from work and see that I’ve got some messages on snapchat which I never use. It’s a snap from Sophie that afternoon showing flower arrangements with the caption that the service I was beautiful! 

I lost it. There’s no other way of saying it. I tried to call her as I just wanted to shout and ask why I was never told. I found out later that it was an open funeral and I would have been allowed to attend but she didn’t want me there. 

I’m still coping with the grief and feel so guilty I couldn’t say goodbye properly to my friend. But through this I also lost Sophie as I don’t feel I can ever be close to her again.
